rationale_overall: The watchlist is pinned at the max_watchlist_size=2 cap with MSFT and NVDA, both representing the profile's current dominant AI/cloud-compute wave. Pass-1 discovery across every named wave surfaced only two structurally interesting candidates with real trading history as of 2022-06-30: Rocket Lab (RKLB, listed 2021-08-25) and NuScale Power (SMR, began trading 2022-05-03). Neither clears the bar to force a swap: RKLB has no dated Q2 commercial catalyst in-window, and SMR has under two months of thin post-de-SPAC trading. On the incumbents, Q2 2022's Fed-hiking drawdown hit both MSFT and NVDA but reads as market-wide multiple compression, not a thesis breach: NVDA's late-May guidance flagged gaming/crypto softness while data-center demand held; Microsoft's cloud franchise remained intact. With no crest signal and no ticker-specific breach, the disciplined call at a 2-slot cap is to hold.
